q2_gaps: "Where is <thing>?" — a thing's position is stored either as (LocatedIn x place) for containment or under an entity-attached surface preposition (On / NextTo / Atop / ...), and the instruction set gives no query doctrine for asking across both storages (position heads are not among the listed dual-storage-union instances), so a where-question can only reach the containment form.
notes: The definite NP is bound by its kind as Queries/Existential prescribe, and feather_store is the correct fused compound kind (a noun modifier classifying the head, genus not exposed in a query). Heads used (Member, LocatedIn) are both defined operators.
